text:
Lena K.: Quick design review request — thinking about the smoothing toggle + outlier clipping behavior for the dashboard charts. TL;DR: need accessible microcopy, keyboard flow, and an obvious visual hint when clipping is active. Devon R.: +1, ran into confusion yesterday where ops thought a spike disappeared. We should show a subtle overlay that says 'outliers hidden' rather than just muting points. Aisha: Agree. From an a11y POV we also need an aria-live region announcing changes so screen reader users know the chart changed state. Keon: Rubber-duck: what if we collapse long y-axis labels when smoothing is on? Might save space but could hide units. Not sure if safe. Lena K.: Good call. Proposal: keep units visible, but de-emphasize them (70% opacity) when smoothing is active. Show a pill indicator at top-left: `Clipping ON` or `Smoothing ON`. Pill is keyboard-focusable. Devon R.: Microcopy options for the pill: - Option A: "Outliers hidden" - Option B: "Showing smoothed series" - Option C: "Outliers clipped — view raw" Which one telegraphs the state and invites action? I lean B for smoothing, A for clipping. Aisha: For screen reader strings: use clear verbs. Example: `aria-live=\"polite\"` content -> "Chart updated: outliers hidden" or "Chart updated: smoothing enabled". Include a visible focus target with `aria-describedby` that points to the pill text. Keon: CSS/HTML stub I sketched: ```css .chart-pill { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.06); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 12px; outline: none; } .chart-pill:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(66,153,225,0.4); } ``` Keon: And the HTML for a11y: ```html
Smoothing enabled
``` Lena K.: Nice. Two UX nits: 1) pill text should be actionable — e.g., "Smoothing ON — View raw" (short) so keyboard users know they can toggle. 2) For color contrast ensure pill meets 4.5:1 ratio for normal text or provide focus outline. Aisha: Also recommend announcing magnitude of hidden outliers in the message — e.g., "Chart updated: 2 outliers hidden (tap to view)". Helps blind users understand scale change. Devon R.: Implementation note: backend will return `outlier_count` in the chart metadata. We can wire that into aria-live and the pill subtitle. Keon: UX question: when user hits the pill to 'view raw', do we animate between smoothed and raw? Animations are helpful but must be reduced-motion aware. Lena K.: Yes — prefer crossfade when reduced-motion is not set, otherwise instant swap. Add a tiny animation spec: 180ms ease for opacity. Aisha: Accessibility checklist I want in the PR: keyboard focus order includes pill, aria-live updates include counts, pill has `aria-pressed` state, label text ends with hint "(press to toggle)" for clarity. Devon R.: I'll add unit tests for `aria-*` attributes and a visual regression test for the pill showing when outliers exist. Lena K.: Final copy proposals — pick one each for pill + live update: - Clipping copy: "Outliers hidden — View raw" / live: "Chart updated: 3 outliers hidden" - Smoothing copy: "Smoothing ON — View raw" / live: "Chart updated: smoothing enabled" Keon: I prefer the explicit numbers in the live update. Pill shorter: "Outliers hidden" (with hover tooltip "View raw series"). Aisha: OK to ship with pill text and tooltip. Make sure tooltip is accessible (focusable or `aria-label`). Lena K.: Action items: Devon to add `outlier_count` hook + tests; Keon to push CSS/HTML snippet and animation flags; Aisha to add a11y checklist to PR template; Lena will finalize copy and update design tokens (pill color + focus token). Devon R.: I'll open a draft PR with the metadata changes and a sample chart demonstrating both states. ETA EOD tomorrow. :+1: aria-bot: Reminder — Design review scheduled at 11am PT. Please add the draft PR to the review thread.
